and hold your rings as you dip your fingers
and give me your sign of approval.

@@U04326@@
I find it difficult just now
to turn to festive thoughts.
But no matter. A joyous beginning
is always best.

@@U04327@@
(To the THIRD PRINCE.)

@@U04328@@
You, sir, I appoint my Lord Steward.
Yours is to oversee the hunt,
the poultry yards and the farm.
And then to prepare with skill and consummate care
the choicest delicacies a season has to offer.

@@U04330@@
I shall happily forego food, Majesty,
till any given dish has met your approval.
The kitchen staff and I will conspire together
to procure the choicest viands from distant regions,
and well before their seasons.
And yet, Sire,
such luxuries mean little to you
who prefer the nourishing and simple.

@@U04332@@
(To the FOURTH PRINCE.)

@@U04333@@
Our unfailing topic being feasts and festivities,
you, young hero, I appoint my Lord Cupbearer.
It is your charge to see that our cellars
are always well stocked with the finest.
And be moderate, you hear?
Don't let opportunity get the better of you.

@@U04335@@
Give youth a chance, Majesty,
and it will achieve maturity before you know it.
I, too, see myself at that great feast,
translation:
@@U04324@@
握住戒指并浸入手指
并给我你的认可标志。

@@U04326@@
我现在觉得很难
转向节日的想法。
但没关系。欢乐的开始
总是最好的。

@@U04327@@
（对三皇子。）

@@U04328@@
您，先生，我任命我的管家大人。
你的职责是监督狩猎，
家禽饲养场和农场。
然后以娴熟的技巧和完美的细心做好准备
当季精选的美味佳肴。

@@U04330@@
我会很高兴放弃食物，陛下，
直到任何一道菜都得到您的认可。
我和厨房工作人员一起密谋
从遥远的地区采购最好的食物，
早在他们的季节之前。
然而，陛下，
这样的奢侈品对你来说意义不大
喜欢营养又简单的人。

@@U04332@@
（对四王子。）

@@U04333@@
我们永恒的主题是盛宴和庆祝活动，
你，年轻的英雄，我任命我的酒政大人。
您有责任检查我们的酒窖
总是备有最好的库存。
而且要温和，听到了吗？
不要让机会战胜你。

@@U04335@@
陛下，请给年轻人一个机会，
在你不知不觉中它就会成熟。
